assertions.description: The browser recognises the "compression-dictionary" link relation keyword via relList.supports (the entry point for the whole feature).
Setting link.rel = "compression-dictionary" round-trips and appears in the element's relList.
Compression Dictionary Transport requires a secure context; this page must be served securely for the feature to operate.
Chrome 156: fetching a <link rel="compression-dictionary"> sets the request destination to "compression-dictionary" (observable server-side as Sec-Fetch-Dest), rather than only marking the initiator.
assertions.test: Requires a server echo route that reports the request's Sec-Fetch-Dest. Wire the /dict-echo route (see build handoff) and run the link-request-semantics concept behind the CDTNewDestination flag to verify.

assertions.description: A response advertising Use-As-Dictionary is stored, and a later matching request carries Available-Dictionary (SHA-256), Dictionary-ID, and dcb/dcz in Accept-Encoding.
assertions.test: Requires a server that emits Use-As-Dictionary and echoes subsequent request headers. Wire the /dict-echo routes (see build handoff) and run the dictionary-negotiation concept in a secure context with the feature enabled.
